title: Flex wallet
tagline: Sending money? Merchant checkouts? Holding digital assets? Just FLEX it!
description:
The flex wallet is an upgrade to the existing digital wallets. This is a wallet for everyone, whether you are familiar with crypto or not. It uses blockchain technology to give a great user experience (much needed in digital wallets), more security, and more custody to anyone who uses it. It makes your life easier by giving you a smooth user experience by embedding your everyday payments. You can also use the Flex wallet to hold digital assets and collectibles.

how_its_made: The main challenge was to provide crypto-related activities and functions and user experience to people who know nothing about crypto. I got over it by talking to more and more people about it. Getting to know what people really want from a digital wallet and keeping everything simple.
